title: Native Crash reader rejects invalid mode and restores exact state

verification.actor: Current mounted Cyndaquil155, its own follower identity and player anchor.
verification.trigger: Complete one stationary wall Crash and rightward recovery, then set only native motion mode to255 through the paused reader and restore.
verification.observable: The original six Crash rows pass before calibration. The same reader rejects mode255. All184 state bytes, poses, bindings, input, registers and clocks are restored without guest execution. Failure remains latched and execution is forbidden afterward.
